title: Fate of a Fighter
description: A taciturn wounded soldier is hiding inside a damaged boat on Nazuchi Beach — just another one of the thousand other tragedies that plague Yashiori Island, where the war has reached a temporary standstill...

mainQuestExcel.title: Fate of a Fighter
mainQuestExcel.description: A taciturn wounded soldier is hiding inside a damaged boat on Nazuchi Beach — just another one of the thousand other tragedies that plague Yashiori Island, where the war has reached a temporary standstill...

dialogs.text: Hmph, how humiliating...
Hey! We saved your life! What do you mean we're "humiliating"?
He's talking about himself, Paimon...
To think that I had to be rescued by outlanders, and was even reduced to being judged by them...
Oh... So, Mr. Samurai, are you alright?
Well, he seems alright, at least.
I am in your debt, outlander.
Also, you fought commendably.
#I'm {NICKNAME}. Pleased to meet you.
Don't look down your nose at me, outlander.
...Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. Just call me Kyuuzou.
So, who were those people?
They're pirates. They have many strongholds around Nazuchi Beach.

Thugs, out-of-work miners and fishermen, fugitives running from the Vision Hunt Decree, deserters from both sides of the war... Sometimes, they gather into groups and degenerate into bandits and pirates. They try, in vain, to escape the control of Her Excellency.
Whether you call them Vagrants or Kairagi, they are all lawless thugs... We had been suppressing them for a while until the rebels destroyed the ward on the island...
The refugees from Tatarasuna and the mine fled in quick succession, and some of those rats scurried off to this place, swelling the ranks of these pirate gangs and making them more reckless.
That group of pirates just now came from the camp in the south, and they had their eyes on the cargo onboard.
Unfortunately for them, I ruined their plans... Hehe...
So this isn't your ship, then?
This thing? It belonged to the Sangonomiya rebels. I am not so sure myself... Either way, when I came, it was already deserted.
So I've stayed and lived in it like a hermit crab till now.
Hah, it's been a long time since I spoke so much. How exhausting...
If you do not mind, I will need your help with something. Once my wound has healed, I will surely return the favor I owe...
I need you to help me clear out the nearby pirate camp that I mentioned earlier.
That's the only way to stop them from coming back here and bothering me like a pack of stray dogs. It might even send the other pirate camps a message, so they don't get any ideas.
It'll also let me see what you can do. How about it?
Piece of cake.
Hmph. It seems you are fond of talking big...
By the way, outlander...
Don't get too conceited. Miss a step, and you might break your leg.
Be right back.
Why were you attacked?
Well, his pride is certainly hurt.
This is something unique to samurai...
I'm tired. Please forgive my lack of hospitality.

flow.stepDescription: Report the situation to Inaba Kyuuzou

dialogs.text: You've returned.
Cleaned them up.
Huh, the atmosphere got weird all of a sudden...
I must apologize for asking you, an outsider, to do my dirty work.
You're being a lot more polite than when we first met.
I've used up all the medicinal herbs I had.
I have run out of herbs to dress my wound, but it is still quite inflamed...
But please... You needn't worry about me. I can hold on.
Take care of your own business, go.
You're such a kid.
What did you say?
We're talking about you. You're acting like a child.
You're clearly in a really bad way, and you look like you're about to cry for help, but still, you're acting like a tough guy... You're not honest at all!
Only kids do that.
And don't forget, Mr. Kyuuzou.
You still owe us.
Hmph... you two...
In that case, please find some Naku weed for me. It can be found everywhere on this island. Full leaves are the best, the liquid can be squeezed out and applied to the wound to reduce inflammation...
That's all. I'm going to take a nap now, so leave me alone.
We're here to help.
Is your wound better?
You should have peace and quiet for a while.
You're back. Stay safe while you're on this island.
Will these be enough?
It will take a long time to mash the herbs into a paste. You can go now.
No, don't get me wrong. I'm not driving you away...
Come back after a while. It's good to have someone to chat with.
I understand.
Take care, outlander.
Take care of your wounds.

flow.stepDescription: Wait till 10:00 – 12:00 the next day and talk to Inaba Kyuuzou
Report the situation to Inaba Kyuuzou

dialogs.text: Outlander, how have you been?
I apologize. This is no place for guests.
Still... I'm glad you could come.
You look much better now.
All thanks to you. Once again, I am in your debt.
Haha, isn't it a pity that I've survived yet again?
Isn't that a good thing? Why's that a pity?
What's next for you?
I haven't made my mind up about what to do next, but I don't think I'll go back.
Kujou Masahito is not a bad person, but his old man is calling for deserters to be caught and punished...
I cannot afford to get on the wrong side of him.
Maybe I'll take off my armor. It's been nice, living alone here...
But until we have peace, there's no point deceiving myself. My memories assert that I am still that same wounded, bloodstained soldier...
*sigh* And who knows what might happen in the future?
Well, as I was saying, I had never doubted the decisions of Her Excellency, so I think that even if I died, I would die with no regrets, right?
Well, this conversation suddenly got heavy...
Ah, speaking of which, it's time for me to visit my old comrades in arms, who are still with me on this island.
In Inazuma's tradition, we offer our fallen comrades a Dendrobium, a delicate and noble flower... A symbol of the fate of all samurai.
By the way, if you meet my old comrades in arms in your journey, please stop for a moment and get to know them.
Have you ever thought about going back?

flow.stepDescription: Clear the nearby monster camps discarded

dialogs.text: ...And it seems that the rats nearby have begun scurrying about again.
Watch out for pirates if you wander around these parts, outlander.
Thank you.
You're welcome.
They shall be no match for me.
Haha, again with the big talk...
Only say that once you've finally gotten rid of them all!
You have a deal.
Yes, that we do.
An outlander? Interesting...
If you're a tourist, you've come to the wrong place.
What are you doing here?
What, are you from the Shogunate?
No.
Then mind your own business.
This guy's so rude!
The Shogunate sent me, alright.
Why you outlanders...
In front of the Commissioner, you beg like dogs, but in front of us Inazuman samurai, you act all high and mighty...
Running here, spying there, stirring things up everywhere... And now you come all the way to this broken boat, for archons only know what.
Well, too bad. I'm just a wounded soldier. There's nothing I can do for you.
So if it pleases you, kindly get out of here.
Doesn't this guy have any manners at all?
Whatever. You're too noisy.
Before you leave, let me give you a piece of advice: don't stay on Yashiori Island for too long. This island has been cursed.
Cursed?
What are you, deaf? I said that this island is cursed.

This never-ending stalemate, the ambitions of our lords, the despair of the common folk, the hatred welling up from the innocent victims, the charnel-sick of vulneraries filling the rooms of dying old people...
It's all a curse.
Leave before you get crushed under its weight.
Paimon didn't get him at all. What a weirdo.
It's you again!?
Didn't I tell you to... Oh, forget it. Do as you like.
Just don't mess around with my things. There are just enough supplies on the ship for you. Leave as soon as you are satisfied.
Would you like some help?
No. Can't you see that I'm doing just fine?
But your wound...
It's my wound, not yours.
Hey, we asked out of kindness!
Then I also answer you out of kindness: don't bother me.
I can help you.
How can you help me, hand me over to the shogunate?
Haha, I'd advise you against such misguided mercy... I will be treated as a deserter, and Lord Kujou has never shown mercy to deserters.
If you really want to help me, then give me some peace and quiet.
Wow, this guy is so grumpy!
Stop bothering me. Find some other way to occupy yourself.
